title: Codex does not read the repo's CLAUDE.md or other existing instruction files
symptoms: Codex ignores rules that Claude Code follows from CLAUDE.md
A TEAM_GUIDE.md or similar file is never loaded
cause: In each directory Codex reads AGENTS.override.md, then AGENTS.md, and other names only when they are listed in project_doc_fallback_filenames. Fallback names are tried only where no AGENTS.md exists.
fix: List the extra filenames in config.toml, or add an AGENTS.md that points to the shared file.
affected: Codex CLI, IDE extension, and ChatGPT desktop app, as of 2026-10
